rule: smallest m with variance explained >= 0.998; otherwise the smallest m within 0.001 of the range's best (plateau)
variance_explained_definition: 1 - var(observed - fitted) / var(observed), over off-diagonal (between-population) covariances, as TreeMix's get_f()

identifiable_range.basis: no m reached 0.998; smallest m within 0.001 of the best variance explained in 0..2 (0.9969)

note: With 4 populations TreeMix supports at most ~2 identifiable migration edges. m = 0..5 was run as the method specifies; picks with m > 2 should be interpreted with caution.
